blurb: Guests fish for lake trout, landlock Atlantic salmon, brown trout, rainbow trout, steelhead, and other species on Lake Champlain. Trips are private and operate from April 1st through late September for large boats, with a casting and jigging boat running year round depending on weather. Ice fishing adventures are also offered with all gear, bait, and shelters supplied.
